mn84:10.7: tameva tvaṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gaccha yamahaṃ saraṇaṃ gatoti.

mn84:10.9: parinibbuto kho mahārāja, etarahi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddhoti.
mn84:11.1: sace hi mayaṃ bho kaccāna, suṇeyyāma taṃ bhagavantaṃ dasasu yojanesu, dasapi mayaṃ yojanāni gaccheyyāma taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ.
mn84:11.2: sace hi mayaṃ bho kaccāna, suṇeyyāma taṃ bhagavantaṃ vīsatiyā yojanesu, tiṃsatiyā yojanesu, cattāḷīsāya yojanesu, paññāsāya yojanesu, paññāsampi mayaṃ yojanāni gaccheyyāma taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ.
mn84:11.3: yojanasate cepi mayaṃ bho kaccāna, suṇeyyāma taṃ bhagavantaṃ, yojanasatampi mayaṃ gaccheyyāma taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ.
mn84:11.4: yato ca kho bho kaccāna, parinibbuto so bhagavā, parinibbutampi mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
